# Chembience Core

> Containerized cheminformatics platform: core Docker images for Django, FastAPI, JupyterLab, and RDKit plus PostgreSQL 18 with the RDKit cartridge, and templates from which `./install` / `./build` generate standalone applications with Docker Compose and Kubernetes (Helm, GHCR) production bundles.

Python 3.14, RDKit (micromamba), PostgreSQL 18 + RDKit cartridge, Docker Compose, Helm. The release version is in `VERSION`.

## Guides

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Guide for AI agents and contributors: working contexts, commands, verification per change type, definition of done, guardrails, repository map
- [README.md](README.md): Overview, quick starts per app type, testing, secrets, releases
- [K8S_INGRESS.md](K8S_INGRESS.md): Kubernetes Ingress controller, TLS, and cert-manager setup
- [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md): Release history

## Core images and templates

- [django/](django/): Django core image; app templates in `django/app/` (includes the RDKit smoke-test app)
- [fastapi/](fastapi/): FastAPI core image; app templates in `fastapi/app/` (Alembic migrations)
- [jupyter/](jupyter/): JupyterLab core image; app templates in `jupyter/app/`
- [rdkit/](rdkit/): RDKit base image (parent of the other three); app templates in `rdkit/app/`
- [postgres/](postgres/): PostgreSQL 18 image with the RDKit cartridge
- [docker-compose.yml](docker-compose.yml): Core image builds and bootstrap services

## Shared code and tooling

- [share/chembience/](share/chembience/): Shared Python package (`from chembience import db`)
- [share/entrypoint/helpers.sh](share/entrypoint/helpers.sh): Helpers sourced by every container entrypoint (template sync rules)
- [prod-tools/](prod-tools/): Production bundle files: database tools, `lib/prepare-prod.sh`, Helm chart base
- [test](test): Fast test entry point (`./test`, `--strict`, `--integration`)
- [tests/](tests/): Production workflow, integration, and prepare-prod comparison tests
